details:
Project Details – The Forgotten Explorers

The Forgotten Explorers is an interactive storytelling website that highlights NASA's abandoned and inactive exploration equipment on the Moon and Mars. It allows users to discover the stories behind these machines, understand their missions, and learn why they remain on planetary surfaces even after their missions have ended.

The website works as an interactive learning experience. Users can explore a planetary globe, browse individual mission stories, view a timeline, examine visual data, and test their knowledge through a quiz. It features historic equipment such as the Sojourner, Spirit and Opportunity rovers, Surveyor 3, the Lunar Roving Vehicles, and the Ingenuity helicopter.

The main benefit of the project is that it makes space exploration history more engaging and accessible. Instead of presenting information as ordinary text, it combines storytelling with interactive features to help visitors understand the achievements and scientific contributions of these missions. Its intended impact is to increase public interest in planetary exploration, preserve the stories of important space missions, and encourage curiosity about science and technology.

The website was developed using HTML, CSS, and JavaScript for its structure, design, and interactive functionality. NASA's publicly available information and imagery resources were used to support the mission content and visual experience.

The creative aspect of the project is its focus on equipment that is often overlooked. Space exploration is usually presented through successful landings and active missions, but our project shifts attention towards the machines that completed their journeys and remain behind. We turn these forgotten pieces of exploration history into stories that visitors can discover and interact with.

During development, our team considered scientific accuracy, ease of navigation, accessibility of information, visual presentation, and user engagement. We aimed to create an experience that is informative for people with different levels of knowledge about space, while making the history of NASA's lunar and Martian exploration interesting to explore.
